analysed_document.note: This is the artifact `klt yield`'s own `samples` field names, and therefore the artifact `klt signoff` hashes for a citation of the report beside it (docs/cli/signoff.md, '`klt yield` evidence and content hashing'). It is a document this runner derived -- the nominal campaign's own per-sample values plus the negative control's -- because `klt sim` cannot express a negative_control on its own response (2AMLogic/klayout-tools#2563). The nominal campaign response it was built from is pinned under `source_campaign` and its statistics are cross-checked against a direct analysis of it; both are committed and append-only.

experiment.claim: Substantiates spec/target-spec.md's ratified "Output" row (1.8V +-2%, i.e. 1.764V-1.836V) against the LDO core-regulation-loop schematic landed by #14 and revised by #22 (current limit / soft start) and #25/#36 (current-mirror-OTA rail-to-rail output stage plus sized Miller compensation) (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch) under per-instance device mismatch, at a single representative operating point (nominal VIN=3.3V/27C/tt process corner, I_LOAD=1mA light load -- the same light-load convention sim/psrr-dc/ already uses). That row is ratified by issue #1 / DR-006, and the bound cited below is the ratified row's own window, not an invented final limit. This is a mismatch-only statistical check (klt sim's monte_carlo.vary="mismatch"): it re-runs this one PVT point N times with a fresh per-instance AGAUSS mismatch draw each time (sky130A's tt_mm .lib section -- see sim/README.md and docs/cli/sim.md in 2AMLogic/klayout-tools), NOT a re-run across the full PVT corner matrix (that is corner-run.py's separate job, e.g. sim/dropout-vs-load). Initial-condition contract (#164): the transient starts from the block's disabled state (all nodes 0, EN low) and powers up through its own soft-start ramp, the same enable-edge convention sim/startup uses -- it does NOT start from an unconstrained ngspice `.op`. That `.op` is not a physically realizable state of this block: on this very sample sequence it warned on 43/200 draws, and on a nearly disjoint set of 12 (only one draw, mc142, is in both -- the other 11 converged with no complaint at all, which is exactly why the resulting settled transient looked like an equilibrium) it handed the transient a start state with FB at 668-1984 V (up to 1.3e15 V) while VOUT sat at VIN -- FB above the only node feeding it through a passive resistor string, which the sky130 poly-resistor model's non-monotone voltage-coefficient term admits as a numerical solution and a transient then holds flat. See design/README.md "#164" for the measurement and the four-variant screen. Known-remaining-gaps caveat (design/README.md "Known gaps / follow-on scope"): the #25/#36 revision closed the unsized-compensation and error-amplifier output-swing-ceiling gaps that dominated the #18-era records, but the pass device's own light-load pole and the absent Iq budget remain open, so a FAIL here is an honest finding about the current design state, not a harness defect.
experiment.title: Output accuracy under device mismatch (Monte Carlo, sky130A tt_mm)

measurements.name: vout_ss

negative_control.description: seeded known-bad variant `mc-output-accuracy-negctl` record 20260927-092313-227be3e | N=40, vary=mismatch, seed=20260817 | declared netlist_patch: `XR_FB_A VOUT FB 0 sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po W=0.42 L=180 mult=1 m=1` -> `XR_FB_A VOUT FB 0 sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po W=0.42 L=198 mult=1 m=1` | rationale: Mis-ratio the feedback divider's top leg by +10% (XR_FB_A L=180um -> 198um), moving the ideal regulation point 1.8V -> 1.86V: +3.33%, i.e. 1.67x the ratified +-2% Output window and ~2.8 sigma past its upper edge in the nominal campaign's own measured mismatch sigma of 8.52mV. Chosen as the canonical accuracy defect for this block (a divider ratio error is exactly what a +-2% output-accuracy row is there to catch), deliberately sized to be decisively out of window while still leaving the loop regulating so the samples stay measurable. Applied to the netlisted deck rather than to design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch so the design keeps one source of truth; the asserted occurrence count makes the patch fail loudly if the divider it targets ever changes.
